definition: The Bulgarian Sense-annotated Corpus (BulSemCor) (Bulgarian: Български семантично анотиран корпус (БулСемКор)) is a structured corpus of Bulgarian texts in which each lexical item is assigned a sense tag.
details: BulSemCor was created by the Department of Computational Linguistics at the Institute for Bulgarian Language of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences.

explainer.lead: BulSemCor is a collection of Bulgarian texts whose lexical items carry labels identifying their intended senses. It provides a structured reference for working with word meaning in Bulgarian, rather than treating every occurrence of a word as equivalent.

tiers.eli5: Some words can mean more than one thing, just as a bat can be an animal or something used to hit a ball. BulSemCor is like a Bulgarian reading collection with notes explaining which meaning each word has in its sentence.
tiers.practitioner: BulSemCor supplies sense-tagged Bulgarian text for language-processing work. When using it, preserve the link between each lexical item and its sense tag, and distinguish the corpus itself from any model trained or evaluated with it.
tiers.paperLevel: BulSemCor, the Bulgarian Sense-annotated Corpus, is a structured corpus in which each lexical item is assigned a sense tag; formally, item i is associated with a sense label s_i. It was created by the Department of Computational Linguistics at the Institute for Bulgarian Language of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences.

explainer.example: In the Bulgarian sentence "Тя сресва косата си", the word "коса" would receive the sense corresponding to hair, rather than its sense as a scythe.

usedIn.name: Bulgarian word-sense disambiguation
usedIn.detail: Provides sense-annotated text for work on selecting a word's contextually intended meaning.

usedIn.name: Bulgarian corpus linguistics
usedIn.detail: Supports examination of lexical items together with their annotated senses.

explainer.measures: BulSemCor does not measure performance with a numerical score. It records the sense assigned to each lexical item in its Bulgarian texts.
howScored: Take a lexical item in a Bulgarian text.
Assign the item a tag identifying its sense.
Store the annotated items in a structured corpus.
explainer.formula: lexical item i -> sense tag s_i
explainer.typicalResults: The result is Bulgarian text enriched with sense tags, not an accuracy percentage or leaderboard result.
caveats: A sense tag describes a lexical item; it is not a model score.
Sense interpretation depends on the distinctions made by the corpus's annotation scheme.

diagram.caption: BulSemCor links lexical items in Bulgarian texts to sense tags in a structured corpus.
